hero.alt: The brick corner storefront of Otto's High Dive in Orlando's Milk District, with its vertical neon sign
hero.caption: Otto's High Dive in the Milk District — one of the ten restaurants in this guide, not a symbol of the wider Magical Dining program.
hero.author: Dclemens1971
hero.modificationNotice: Resized, cropped for display and converted to WebP. The adaptation is released under the same licence.
hero.verification: Downloaded the original (4732x2661) from Wikimedia Commons and viewed it directly: the file's own description reads "Otto's High Dive, a Cuban restaurant and rum bar in Orlando, Florida", and the corner building's vertical 'OTTO'S High Dive' sign is visible on the brick facade next to the painted 'ABUNDANCIA' signage of the same building, confirming the exact restaurant this pick names. Not geotagged.
